audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart in both layers reads Graves/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Graves, which contradicts the packet chart (Skill, Graves, Graves, Urgot, Graves, Urgot, Urgot), the 45.83% win rate, and the whys[] text itself — whys[0] says neither can punish at 1, whys[3]/[5]/[6] all describe Urgot winning.
audit.why: The prose already agrees with the packet chart; only the side tokens were wrong. A chart that says 'Skill' where the text says 'he out-DPSes you' misleads on the two moments the player actually has to decide.
audit.corrected: win[0..6] and phases[0..6].side set to Skill/Graves/Graves/Urgot/Graves/Urgot/Urgot with ratings 5,6,6,4,6,4,3.

audit.why: Spike structure (levels 2-3 window, level 6 Collateral Damage, first item, late) matches the kit: Graves' E is 16/15/14/13/12s and Urgot's Purge falls to 0 mana / 0 cooldown at rank 5, so his scaling really does invert the lane.
audit.corrected: Spike text tightened with real numbers; R's 100/80/60s cooldown now stated at level 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two fabricated mechanics. (a) 'Smoke Screen's blind only stops basic attacks' — Graves' W is not a blind; Riot's text says it 'creates a cloud of smoke that reduces sight range', i.e. a nearsight plus an impact slow. (b) 'fire R into a wall to knock yourself free' of Disdain — Collateral Damage's text is damage to the first champion and a cone explosion; no self-displacement appears anywhere in the kit. Also 'his W deals percent-max-HP' is asserted three times; Riot's Purge text says nothing about percent health and the derived flags do not include percentHealth (Echoing Flames is the leg-blast trigger and its text says only physical damage).
audit.why: A player told W blinds will step into Purge expecting his damage to stop. A player told R breaks Disdain will throw a 100-second ultimate into a wall and die. Both are inventions, and the percent-HP claim cannot be verified from Riot's text.
audit.corrected: W described as nearsight + impact slow used to break his target and disengage; R described as a 100s cooldown spent on his commit; Purge described by what the text does say — free at rank 5 (0 mana, no cooldown) and triggering Echoing Flames.

audit.why: Disdain at 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s is genuinely the punishable cooldown and the page already keys forward steps to it.
audit.corrected: Cooldown number added where advice needed to be concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: Graves' passive — four bullets that cannot pass through units — is never mentioned, and it is the reason point-blank matters against a champion who fights in his own minions.
audit.why: Minion-block on the pellets is the mechanical reason 'half-range trades scatter' is true; without it that advice reads as flavour.
audit.corrected: Left the existing point-blank framing; not adding a claim about pellet spread beyond what Riot's text supports.

edits.before: Urgot is short-range like you, so levels 2-3 are your window: lead with Q's powder trail, E in for a point-blank 4-shell volley, then E back out before he can answer. Note that Smoke Screen's blind only stops basic attacks — it does NOT stop his W shotgun shots or his Q, so save W to disengage or block his autos rather than expecting it to shut off his DPS. Do not stand and trade autos: his W deals percent-max-HP and chips through your True Grit armor no matter how much you stack, so every trade must be a quick burst then dash out. Reloading your two-shell magazine in his face is how you eat a free Q-into-shotgun-leg combo.
edits.after: Urgot is short-range like you, so levels 2-3 are your window: lead with Q's powder trail, E in for a point-blank 4-shell volley, then E back out before he can answer. Smoke Screen nearsights — it cuts his sight range and slows on impact, it does not blind, so drop it between you to break his target and walk out, not to switch off his damage. Do not stand and trade: Purge costs him nothing at rank 5 — 0 mana, no cooldown — and every burst triggers Echoing Flames, so each trade is one volley then dash. Reloading your two-shell magazine in his face is how you eat a free Corrosive Charge into Purge.

edits.before: Once Urgot has a tank item online he wins the stand-still fight — his W shots do percent-max-HP, so your armor stacking barely slows him. Level 6 is your one real reset: Collateral Damage plus a full shell volley can chunk him, and if he flips you with E you can fire R into a wall to knock yourself free. Never get greedy and walk in for the kill — his E flip will yank you back into his W cloud, and once you're low his R locks you in the suppress-execute for a free kill.
edits.after: Once Urgot has a tank item online he wins the stand-still fight — Purge is free at rank 5, 0 mana and no cooldown, and keeps triggering Echoing Flames. Level 6 is your one real reset: Collateral Damage plus a full shell volley can chunk him, and it is only up every 100s at rank 1, so spend it on his commit. Never walk in greedy — Disdain hurls you back into his range on a 16s cooldown, and once you are low Fear Beyond Death impales and executes you.

edits.before: This is his half of the lane. In a long fight his percent-HP shots shred you while your burst barely dents his tank stats, and his R suppress-executes any commit when you drop below the threshold. Use your mobility to skirmish elsewhere and split — do not facecheck him 1v1 in the side lane where he can flip-and-execute. Your only path is having snowballed the 2-3 and level-6 windows; if it went even, respect the E-flip-into-R chain and refuse the sustained fight he is built to win.
edits.after: This is his half of the lane. In a long fight Purge plus Echoing Flames shreds you while your burst barely dents his tank stats, and Fear Beyond Death executes any commit once you drop below the threshold. Use your mobility to skirmish elsewhere and split — do not facecheck him 1v1 in the side lane where Disdain starts the chain. Your only path is having snowballed the 2-3 and level-6 windows; if it went even, respect the Disdain-into-R chain and refuse the sustained fight he is built to win.

notes: Two fabricated mechanics removed and the level chart re-aligned to the packet chart (the prose already agreed with it; only the side tokens disagreed). Percent-max-health language on Urgot's Purge is unverifiable from Riot's text and the derived flags, so it was replaced with what the text does state rather than asserted or denied. diffRating left at 5.5/10 — 45.83% is close enough to even that changing it was not warranted.
